contracts_rationale: The mission defines no interface of its own: it consumes the charter-owned contracts (PackDoctorReport, anti-pattern.schema.json, the pack-doctor command line), recorded in research.md R2/R4 and data-model.md.
friendly_name: Align open-packs to charter main with pack-doctor
purpose_context: The charter renamed its standalone checker to pack-doctor and now refuses inline anti-patterns, stale manifests and unresolved references on every surface. Open-packs' nightly run against charter main is red (#343). This mission moves the pin tooling, report parsing, pack content and fixtures to what charter main ships, so pack authors get one answer from the charter instead of a drifting Python copy.
purpose_tldr: Make every open pack pass the charter's own pack checker at charter main, and retire the Python copies of its rules.
